convention:
Rational SU(2) degree-four covariants; Dicke order r=0,...,12.
f(z,w)=sum C(12,r)*x_r*z^(12-r)*w^r, T f=sum (-1)^r C(12,r)*y_(12-r)*z^(12-r)*w^r.
y denotes independent conjugates. Physical c_r=sqrt(C(12,r))*x_r.
Covariant component polynomials are RAW binary-form coefficients: squarednorm=sum |F_r|²/C(2L,r).
monomialFormat: sorted list of variable indices, repetitions allowed
